meta.name: qa
meta.description: Exercise the delivered customer journey using real runtime or browser evidence. Use for functional acceptance testing after implementation, including failure paths.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把交付的功能真实跑一遍,连失败路径也一起验证
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果功能刚做完,想知道真实使用中会不会出问题
copy.tagline_en: Run the delivered journey for real and verify it, failure paths included
copy.fit_line_en: For you if the feature is just built and you want proof it works in real use

howto.what: 它会用真实的运行时或浏览器证据,把交付的客户旅程实际跑一遍做功能验收测试,失败路径也包含在内。跑不了的能力或未执行的检查会如实报告,不会声称已经通过。
howto.when: 实现完成后需要做功能验收测试时接管,失败路径属于范围内。若由 @fde 调用,则复用它当前的脱敏数据包和范围,不重启设置,也不重复已问过的问题。

say.text: 用真实运行证据走一遍这次交付的客户旅程
say.note: 会实际执行并报告结果

say.text: 把失败路径也纳入这次功能验收
复用 @fde 当前的数据包和范围做验收
say.note: 不重新设置或重复提问

howto.what_en: It exercises the delivered customer journey using real runtime or browser evidence as functional acceptance testing, including failure paths. Missing capabilities or unrun checks are reported honestly, not claimed as passed.
howto.when_en: Use after implementation when functional acceptance testing is needed, including failure paths. When called by @fde, it reuses that sanitized packet and scope instead of restarting setup or re-asking answered questions.

say_en.text: Run through the delivered customer journey with real runtime evidence
Include failure paths in this functional acceptance run
Reuse @fde's current packet and scope for acceptance
